message_1_subject: Onboarding: ACH details for Redwood PO 6789
message_1_body:
Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding call this morning. Per our conversation, attached are VelvetRemit's completed ACH form and a signed W-9. We submitted our company details into your vendor portal earlier today.

We ran a quick internal test from our bank and expect micro-deposits to hit your account by end of day PDT. We typically expect invoices to include invoice_ref and client_po fields — happy to adapt to your schema.

Attachments: VelvetRemit_ACH_Form_20280914.pdf (ACH form, account + routing), W9_VelvetRemit_signed.pdf

Best,
Luca Romano
Head of Finance Operations
VelvetRemit, Inc.
L: +1 415-555-0182
